messages:
sam: Vendor CloudStream flagged a spike on their partner invoice INV-VND-3045. They say the partner meter double-counted 10k embedding tokens; customer-facing amount $1,120 overcharged. Invoice: https://invoices.redwood.dev/INV-VND-3045
maria: Can you attach the partner usage CSV and the vendor dispute thread? Need to confirm whether it's a meter bug or duplicate ingestion.
sam: Attached usage_snippet.csv and vendor-thread.png. Looks like a replay loop from their collector caused duplicated events between 2026-06-02 02:00-03:00 UTC. billing@cloudstream.io is contact.
billing-bot: Alert: Invoice INV-VND-3045 flagged external_meter_duplication. Case ID VEND-2026-3011. Invoice placed on HOLD.
jules: Policy check: external vendor metering errors under $5k can be settled as vendor adjustment if vendor accepts liability. Do we have vendor acceptance?
sam: Vendor accepted liability in their thread and requested Redwood to post a vendor credit and bill them back. They asked for invoice-level credit to the customer and a separate vendor chargeback.
kevin: Approve posting a $1,120 invoice credit to the customer (GL 6501) and create an Accounts Payable chargeback to vendor. Memo: "Vendor meter duplication; vendor accepted liability; case VEND-2026-3011". Approve immediate processing.
maria: Journal entries planned: 1) Customer credit: Debit Sales Discounts (GL6501) $1,120 / Credit AR $1,120. 2) Vendor AP: Debit Cost of Goods Sold (GL 5102) $1,120 / Credit Accounts Payable $1,120 with vendor reference. I'll queue both in tonight's batch.
sam: I'll update vendor thread and attach proof of journal entries once posted. Also asked vendor to provide a postmortem to avoid recurrence.
billing-bot: Case VEND-2026-3011 updated: customer credit queued; vendor chargeback queued.
jules: Note for audit: tag both entries with project=partner-metering and include vendor dispute ID CLOUD-642.
maria: Posted transactions. Customer refund TXN RFND-V-77812. Vendor AP TXN AP-44321. Invoice note updated and ticket linked: https://billing.redwood.internal/tickets/VEND-2026-3011
billing-bot: Case VEND-2026-3011 closed by user maria at 2026-06-18T14:12:05Z.
sam: Thanks team. I'll confirm with CloudStream and let CS know the customer has been refunded. :white_check_mark:
